verdict.rationale: OneDrive is a cloud file storage and sync service, not an AI agent or assistant host. Consuming MCP servers' tools is an MCP-client role, which is a different product role from what this kind of product does. The evidence covers only Graph file APIs, sharing, sync and versioning, and shows no built-in agent that could act as an MCP client, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
